newsitem.title: BRAZIL: TENNIS-COURIER GIVES UNITED STATES VICTORY OVER BRAZIL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-COURIER GIVES UNITED STATES VICTORY OVER BRAZIL.

text.p: Jim Courier overcame a gallant challenge from Gustavo Kuerten to give the United States an unbeatable 3-1 lead over Brazil in their Davis Cup world group first round tie on Sunday.

Courier also had to contend with oppressive heat and a partisan crowd as he defeated Kuerten 6-3 6-2 5-7 7-6 in three hours and 40 minutes to hand Brazil their first home defeat in the competition in 10 years.
The former world number one looked like he would stroll through the rubber, taking the first two sets without encountering much resistance.
But Kuerten fought back superbly to take the third set and took the fourth set to a tie-break.
Kuerten, ranked 85th in the world, saved four match points and held two points to level the rubber at two sets each before Courier finally wrapped up the tie at the fifth attempt.
